pages.title: Essences of the Forge
pages.text: The forge stores four essences: Aureal, Souls, Blood and Experience.$()

pages.title: Aureal
pages.text: Aureal Bottles replenish Aureal; Arcane Crystal Obelisks produce it slowly.$(br2)An obelisk only works above Gilded Chiseled Polished Darkstone. The gilded supply positions around a forge are suitable.

pages.name: Obelisk Blueprint
pages.text: Use Mundabitur Dust to complete the transformation.

pages.title: Blood
pages.text: Build your forge near a combat area: injured creatures can supply Blood. Attack while holding a test tube in your offhand to collect Blood, then transfer it to the forge.

pages.title: Experience
pages.text: A Petrified Orb supplies 91 Experience essence; a Bottle o' Enchanting supplies 15. The Experience input can also strip enchantments from equipment. Corrupted Crystal Obelisks provide a slow, renewable supply.

pages.name: Corrupted Obelisk
pages.text: Use Mundabitur Dust to complete the transformation.
Extract souls from Soul Sand with a Soul Extractor, or defeat Lost Souls. The Soul Looting enchantment gives a chance to summon Lost Souls.
